title: Curating Grounded Synthetic Data with Global Perspectives for Equitable AI

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating representation bias by enforcing a balanced country-of-origin distribution (sourcing from 125 countries) in the synthetic training dataset, and evaluating the resulting NER models' zero-shot micro-F1 performance across 18 standard and out-of-domain benchmarks to demonstrate improved global generalization.

Sourcing training data articles across 12 different languages to capture diverse linguistic nuances before translating them, and measuring the downstream improvement in zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) accuracy on diverse datasets.
